keyFindings.description:
verbatimCount counts any '' substring of a raw-HTML span as a close, including one inside an HTML comment or a quoted attribute value, in both markVerbatim and exactBlocks. '


This sentence starts on one line
and ends on the next.' and 'Intro 
 then x

…' are joined with exit 0; GitHub's POST /markdown renders the joined text inside the still-open 
, before with its line break and after without. Fix: count a close only from a token that is exactly a close tag (a whole raw-HTML span or inline html node ''); in HTML block values, skip comments, processing instructions, declarations, CDATA and quoted attribute values before counting closes. Opens may stay loose.
